_comment: Centered-merge N-ladder (log/merge_mechanism/2026-07-15_centered-merge-design.md): the third composition regime — shared ~1x, residuals ~1x — over the SAME e5 per-author pool as Exp-5, so curves overlay exactly. Two non-degenerate estimators of the shared component S (M = sum_i Delta_i - (N-1)*S): centered_pool (S = mean of ALL 199 pool adapters; capped at max_n=64 because subset->pool degenerates the estimator back to the additive mean) and centered_lowrank rho=16 (S = per-slot rank-rho SVD of the subset mean; rho grounded in Exp-1's rank-16 shared col(B) basis; rho=0 == naive sum, rho=full == mean). NOTE the literal PATHS_FORWARD §6.1 formula (S = exact subset mean) is the algebraic identity == additive_mean (already run as Exp-5) and is deliberately NOT run. iso/anchor rows are bit-identical to the e5 campaign's — their result JSONs are COPIED into results/smoke (self-skip) instead of re-evaluated.

centered_lowrank._comment_exact_max_n: was 64; the exact rank-2064 (32*64+rho) fp32 adapter OOMs next to the 7B bf16 base on a 44.5 GiB A40 (eval wave 443532, 6 rows) — N=64 is served via svd1024 instead, trusted by the e5 svd-vs-exact acceptance (|dmu|=0.0007 at N=64).
